title: Release-train choreography: staged waves, cut criteria, and release-notes playbook for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a coordinated release-train playbook that defines milestone choreography, per-component cut criteria, staged rollout waves, and a cross-team release-notes coordination process for API, Console, and Runtime. This ticket will: 1) establish milestone dates and verification gates for QA/Perf/Security; 2) define cut criteria thresholds (latency/SLO regressions, critical bug counts, infra readiness) per surface (hosted API, Console UX, runtime kernels); 3) prescribe staged wave cadence (internal canary, beta customers, general availability) including rollback windows and automatic fallback mappings; 4) create a single release-notes authoring and approval workflow with owner matrix and templates; 5) produce a comms runbook (preflight, embargo, postmortem) and a lightweight triage protocol for last-minute scope reductions. Deliverables: milestone calendar (CSV + calendar invite template), cut-criteria matrix (numeric thresholds + owner signoff), wave rollout matrix (region/tenant segmentation), release-notes templates and ownership table, checklist for preflight veriﬁcation and “go/no-go” signalers. Success metrics: <1% post-release P0 escalations attributable to coordination gaps, 2-week reduction in cross-team sync time during release week, 95% timely approvals on release-notes workflow.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Calendar and milestone gates published and visible to engineering/design/ops; 2) Cut-criteria spreadsheet reviewed and signed by owners for API/Console/Runtime; 3) Release-notes template checked into docs with assigned approvers; 4) Dry run executed in Cycle 2026-W12 with documented handoffs and one simulated rollback; 5) All cross-team owners have runbook acknowledged in Slack and Confluence.
